name: Arecor Therapeutics plc
summary: Arecor Therapeutics PLC is a biopharmaceutical enterprise dedicated to creating therapies for diabetes and various other medical conditions. The company utilizes its exclusive Arestat formulation technology platform to both cultivate its own range of specialized products (for diabetes and other ailments) and collaborate with pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners to refine and enhance existing therapeutic formulations. Its pipeline includes AT247, an exceptionally fast-acting insulin aimed at individuals with Type I and Type II diabetes, and AT278, a highly concentrated rapid-acting insulin formulation engineered to hasten insulin absorption following injection. Established in 2007, the company's main office is situated in Little Chesterford, United Kingdom.
